Interface NeedsExecutionBuilderStage

public interface NeedsExecutionBuilderStage
A stage in a command builder where requirements have already been specified and execution details are required. The next stage is a NeedsNameBuilderStage from executing(Consumer). Additional requirements may still be added before moving on to the next stage.
